This AI tool is a fantastic resource for anyone needing quick, actionable user insights. It allows you to create synthetic personas for focus group discussions (which I think is great for idea generation), or upload your own data to generate real personas-based insights. The AI moderates the discussion, providing a friendly experience. I particularly like the consolidated insights at the end of the discussion for quick reference. The tool is constantly evolving, especially the Figma testing, but it shows great promise. Overall, it’s an efficient, cost-effective solution for user research, and I’d highly recommend it to teams looking for faster, smarter ways to test ideas and prototypes. Great work, Gaayathri! Keep it up :)
